bio: I'm a chemical engineering student at Lagos State University (LASU), Nigeria, focused on energy, oil and gas, pharmaceuticals, IoT integration in chemical processes.
story:
I'm Samuel Godonu, a Chemical Engineering student at Lagos State University, focused on energy, oil and gas, pharmaceuticals, IoT integration in chemical processes.

My hands-on work so far is in process simulation with Aspen Plus and HYSYS, Solid Modeling using Onshape, IoT integrations using Wokwi, TinkerCAD.

Beyond the classroom I run a creative design practice (P.kreatif Designs, since 2020), co-founded The Builders Circle, and serve in student communities for engineers and. I'm eager to learn from and collaborate with peers and professionals in chemical engineering and beyond in tech and innovation.
